metadata.title: Secure Virtualization

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating virtualized compute environments in a manner that preserves isolation, integrity, and platform trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Virtualized compute platforms, hypervisors, and shared host execution environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that physical host trust, virtualization isolation, and hypervisor integrity requirements are collectively satisfied.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure virtualization assumes a trusted physical compute substrate.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure virtualization builds on baseline virtualization isolation guarantees.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure virtualization requires explicit trust in the hypervisor enforcing isolation.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation that compromises virtualization or hypervisor boundaries.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Lateral movement across co-resident virtual machines.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Platform-wide impact resulting from virtualization or hypervisor compromise.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation exploiting virtualization or hypervisor vulnerabilities.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity verification of hypervisor and virtualization platform components.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Reduction of attack surface exposed by virtualization control planes.

metadata.remarks: Secure Virtualization is a composite trust pattern asserting that physical host integrity, virtualization isolation, and hypervisor trust requirements are collectively satisfied. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for threat modeling, solution patterns, and system security and privacy plans.
